scope: One fixed architecture experiment: joint subset selection from frozen authorized post-floor candidates, original atomic text only, then separate reading-order diagnostic. Controlled retrieval I/O; no live SQL/Qdrant/auth/checkpoint E2E or Formal Experiment.
development: Fixed160 already exposed official MuSiQue ans train questions, same cached candidates. NOT blind.
candidate: One bounded DeepSeek call over at most20 original excerpts1000 chars/title/lifecycle/safe positions. Select<=5 distinct original atoms jointly; dependency reading order. No generated answer/reasoning forwarded to reader. No external lookup or extra retrieval. No prompt/model/parameter alternatives.

profiles.legacy5: Accepted rag_records_v1 at8000 with BGE relevance order; common ANSWER_PROMPT from evidence_plan_replay.
profiles.set_rank5: Joint selected set, original BGE order and full DTO byte selection at8000, unchanged rag_records_v1 and original excerpts.
profiles.set_read5: Diagnostic only: reorder exactly the actually admitted set_rank5 fragments using selector reading order, same rendering and question. No new evidence, explanations, generated facts or different answer prompt.

runtime.estimator: existing conservative UTF8-byte token-unit estimator, not provider actual tokens

stage1.metric: complete supporting paragraph set in final admitted context
stage1.decision: Only if ALL pass, issue answer API calls. Otherwise stop this method without more answer calls or confirmation.

stage2.primary: set_rank5 minus legacy5 answer token F1, all planned failures zero
stage2.diagnostic: set_read5 vs set_rank5 descriptive only; cannot replace primary or choose a winner after results.
stage2.interval: Question-weighted paired bootstrap5000 over shared supporting-source components,95%; correlation beyond provided support titles is a limitation.

api_policy: Single attempt, fixed deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017,temp0,max256,no retries or fallback models. Known HTTP400/invalid selection use explicitly reported baseline evidence fallback. Unknown/wrong model/other provider error stops, no silent retry. Invalid>5% stops. Identical answer messages within the SAME question reuse one outcome, including errors; no duplicate paid diagnostics.
confirmation: Only if stage2 accepts: one new200 official dev questions excluding all prior exposed500 question IDs. Freeze candidate/protocol before labels; disclose any source-family overlap. No confirmation reselection. No new exposure if DEV fails.
stop: One candidate/one DEV run/at most one frozen confirmation. Negative result retained; no parameter scan. Default stays accepted baseline unless independent acceptance.

_publication.policy: case text, source corpus, requests, credentials and per-case objects omitted
